metadata.title: Harmonic maps from $\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$ into $\mathbb{CP}^n$ with least Morse index
metadata.abstract: Let $u:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ be a smooth nonconstant harmonic map. We prove that its Morse index is equal to $ 2n+2$ if and only if \begin{equation*} u = h \circ \pi \circ \Xi, \end{equation*} where $\Xi:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$ is an isometric transformation, $\pi:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ is the Hopf map and $h:\mathbb{CP}^n\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ is a holomorphic map with degree one. When $n=1$, it refines a classical result of Urakawa and a recent result of Rivière. Moreover, we prove that $h\circ\pi\circ \Xi$ has nullity $3n^2+5n$.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 球面到复射影空间的最低 Morse 指标分类
analysis.workSummary: 分类 S^{2n+1} 到 CP^n 的非恒定光滑调和映射中 Morse 指标为 2n+2 的情形：它们恰可写成球面等距变换、Hopf 映射与次数一全纯映射的复合，并计算零度为 3n²+5n。
analysis.breakthrough: 把最低指标条件转化为显式几何结构，涵盖并改进 n=1 的既有结果。
analysis.limitations: 末端次数一全纯映射不能直接替换成等距变换；分类限定非恒定光滑调和映射。
analysis.priorityReason: 把最低指标条件转化为显式几何结构，涵盖并改进 n=1 的既有结果。
